title: Policy and charging control framework for the 5G System (5GS)
tagline: Stage-2 policy framework — what SmPolicyDecision represents
summary: TS 23.503 defines the policy and charging control framework at Stage 2, including session management policy, PCC rules, and QoS. For the 29.512 story, it explains the policy concepts that SmPolicyContextData and SmPolicyDecision encode at the SBI layer.
whyItMatters: 29.512 is the API surface; 23.503 is the conceptual model. Understanding PCC rules, QoS data, and policy triggers from Stage 2 makes the 512 data models meaningful rather than opaque JSON schemas.
